title: Concept: Reflective invocation via Type.forName (apex) — review required
description: In apex, Type.forName resolves code by name at runtime. The remedy is a fixed allowlist of class names.
applicability: apex runtime name resolution; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Selection of unintended code or classes when the name is attacker-influenced; MEDIUM because the call alone does not prove data flow.
